Name: Junimo Harvest Chest
Author: Sinbad37
Description:
Junimo Harvest Chest
[quote][b]Turn your Junimo Harvest Chests into a powerful late-game indoor farming and storage system.[/b][/quote]Junimo Harvest Chest adds a Junimo-themed chest that combines [b]automatic harvesting, shared storage, planting, fertilizing, and watering[/b] into one system.
Place multiple Junimo Harvest Chests in [b]greenhouses, sheds, and other indoor locations[/b]. Every Junimo Harvest Chest shares the same inventory, so your Junimos can use centralized seeds, fertilizer, and storage wherever they work.
[line]
[heading]🌱 Features[/heading]
🍃 Automatic Harvesting
Junimos automatically collect:
[list]
[*]Mature crops[/*]
[*]Regrowing crops[/*]
[*]Fruit from fruit trees[/*]
[/list]Harvested items are placed directly into the [b]shared Junimo Harvest Chest inventory[/b].
📦 Shared Storage
All Junimo Harvest Chests use [b]one shared inventory[/b].
Anything stored in one chest is available from every other Junimo Harvest Chest, making it easy to manage [b]seeds, fertilizer, and harvested goods[/b] across multiple indoor growing areas.
[line]
[heading]🧚 Junimo Abilities[/heading]
The mod includes [b]four unlockable abilities[/b].
Abilities are unlocked [b]globally for the save[/b], then enabled or disabled [b]independently for each chest[/b].
🌱 Renewal of the Harvest
Replants harvested crops when matching seeds are available in the shared inventory.
🌾 Blessing of the Earth
Uses fertilizer from the shared inventory when planting, without replacing fertilizer already present on the soil.
🌿 Junimo Sowers
Prepares suitable soil and plants available seeds from the shared inventory.
💧 Junimo Dew
Waters crops and soil automatically.
[line]
[heading]✨ Ability Progression[/heading]
Each ability is unlocked by completing its own [b]Junimo-style material bundle[/b].
Once unlocked, an ability remains available for the save.
Each Junimo Harvest Chest can enable or disable abilities independently, and [b]new chests begin with all abilities disabled[/b].
[quote][b]Skill Progression[/b]
The Skill Progression option can be disabled to make [b]all abilities available immediately[/b].[/quote][line]
[heading]🌟 Chest Evolution[/heading]
The Junimo Harvest Chest changes appearance as abilities are unlocked.
The [b]highest unlocked ability[/b] determines the visual upgrade used by all Junimo Harvest Chests.
[line]
[heading]⭐ Farming Experience[/heading]
By default, automatic harvesting does [b]not[/b] grant Farming experience.
An optional setting can enable the normal Stardew Valley Farming experience for crops harvested by Junimos.
[line]
[b]Let your Junimos take care of the work. 🌱🧚[/b]

Downloads.Description: Adds abilities, shared inventory, API support, Italian translation, indoor-only operation, new visuals, Farming XP and progression options, plus fixes for replanting, fertilizer, chest removal, HUD messages, and partial fruit stacks.
